title: Video Crystal Letter
text: Ren and Itsuki, responding to my summons, came to my house, I say.
“Huh? Ren, Itsuki, what are you two doing here?”
Father showed up too, of all people. That was somewhat unexpected, but well, no matter. If he’d come with Rival in tow, I doubt I could have kept my composure.
“Yeah, apparently Motoyasu sent word calling for me and Itsuki separately.”
“I came here wondering just what this was all about.”
“Hmm…”
Ren and Itsuki knocked on my door, tok tok.
“…No answer?”
“Honestly, calling people over and then not even answering.”
“Doesn’t look like it’s locked, though?”
“Then shall we let ourselves in first? Might be something urgent.”
Ren and Itsuki stepped into my house. Inside, on the table, sat a video crystal I had placed there, along with a note.
“What is this…”
“It’s addressed to us. Says to play the video crystal.”
“Honestly, what is with that man.”
With a weary tone, Itsuki activated the video crystal. It showed footage of me sitting in a chair with Yuki-chan on my lap.
“Yoooo! Ren, Itsuki, you watching?”
The sight of Ren and Itsuki staring in silence, expressionless, was quite something, I say.
“What is this? Sounds like the setup for some cheating drama. The homewrecker would be Motoyasu-kun, I guess, but who’s being cheated on?”
“Going by this footage, wouldn’t it be Yuki-san?”
“Yuki’s Motoyasu’s Filolial, though. Still, he pulls off ‘homewrecker’ disturbingly well.”
“Well, Motoyasu-kun is handsome, after all.”
“Waaah, what’s going on, let Kou join in too, Kitamura!”
“Kuro too!”

Kou and Kuro-chan burst into the frame mid-recording, indeed. Incidentally, this footage was filmed shortly before I made the summons. The two of them came bouncing over, clinging to me as I sat there with Yuki-chan on my lap.
“Went from cheating video to home video real quick.”
“Seriously, what is this?”
“I have no idea what’s going on.”
“Hold on, we’re in the middle of filming right now, I say. Just bear with it a moment.”
“Yaaay, Naofumi-sama, are you watching?”
Yuki-chan, out of consideration for Father, the one hero who hadn’t been summoned, called out his name.
“Why is Yuki-chan saying my name at a time like this? What does that mean, exactly?”
“I don’t think there’s much depth to it with Yuki-san.”
“Yeah. No doubt she has no idea what she just said.”
Reset, I say.
Since re-filming would’ve been a hassle, I just let it roll as-is.
“Now then, the reason I called you two here is no small matter. There is a certain truth I must reveal to you. A major announcement, indeed.”
“What is this? Why would he avoid telling us straight to our faces?”
“Even if he told us directly, he’d probably look like nothing scares him.”
“Apparently there is something he’s afraid of, though.”
“A woman gone mad with obsession, was it? Not exactly something we can do anything about.”

The me in the video, of course, had no way of responding to Father and the others’ conversation with any sense of timing—since the only audience I’d actually pictured was Ren and Itsuki watching this.
“Now, let me reveal it—the one who has worked in the shadows to teach you the truth of this nation… the true identity of the usaunny rabbit is…”
At that moment, I transformed into my usaunny form in a flash.
“Me! Usaunny Motoyasu-pyon! Ren, Itsuki, have you finally understood in your bones just how rotten this country and your companions are, pyon? I figured it was about time to teach you, pyon!”
Bam! I struck a pose. I’d even edited the video crystal to add some dramatic speed lines.
“Usaunny Motoyasu, Shadow Clone Jutsu, I say! Shu shu shu shu!”
With that, the me inside the video crystal used my high stats to move at blinding speed, leaving afterimages behind.
“To all you heroes out there who found this video crystal even slightly entertaining!”
“Don’t forget to subscribe!”
“I’d be absolutely thrilled if you gave it a like, pyon!”

Then, releasing the clone technique, I gave the signal to head out to Yuki-chan and the others, who were still a little startled by my transformation. Yuki-chan seemed to catch on and shifted into her Filolial form.
“Well then, I’ll be heading out for a while, so farewell, pyoooon! Kuro-chan, Kou—could you two go call them over later, pyon?”

“Ohh… the mystical rabbit, having exposed the truth of how it turned the pitch-black swordsman into a beloved pet dog, flees the scene, and so the black fang-and-claw shall relay this as a messenger. When the blood-soaked truth—mysteria—is disclosed, the beloved dog shall return to its true form.”
“Got it! Kou will go fetch Kawasumi!”
“Departure!”
“Departuuure!”
“Kuro-chan, keep the contents secret from Ren for now, I say. After that, the fun begins, indeed.”
“Got it! Once the Dark Holy Hero awakens, he’ll play with me too, right? I’ll invite Keel along later too!”
I was rather hoping that, with Kuro-chan around, it might be the real Ren who returns to himself soon, rather than Rafumi. And with that, the footage stored in the video crystal came to an end.
Having watched it, Father put a hand to his face and shook his head as if lamenting something.
“I mean, there’s no subscribe button or like button… who on earth taught Motoyasu-kun those video site catchphrases?”
In one smooth motion, Itsuki raised his hand, drew his bow, and shot the video crystal clean through. It shattered into countless pieces and vanished.
“I had a feeling it might be something like this… don’t you agree, Ren-san?”
“Yeah. If he’d done his business in that form and kept quiet about it, I was willing to let it slide.”
“To let it slide and then provoke us like this on top of it… no matter what, we’ll hunt him down and nail him to a cross.”
“Right! Time for a rabbit hunt!”
And with that, Ren and Itsuki dashed out of my house.

“Well… I figured it was only a matter of time before something like this came out, given how everyone’s been quietly hinting he ought to confess something lately, but did he really have to provoke them like this…”
Father muttered, watching the backs of Ren and Itsuki as they rushed off.
Father fell silent for some reason. Then, after glancing around the room and thinking it over for a moment, he said,
“Don’t tell me, Motoyasu-kun… are you hiding somewhere watching?”
Oh-ho, well spotted, indeed! I swiftly canceled my concealment and revealed myself. Of course, still in usaunny form!
“Well spotted indeed, Father! This Motoyasu is truly humbled by your keen powers of observation.”
“Wow, you really were there. Well… I figured you probably would be, without a doubt. You seem like the type who’d make sure to confirm the reaction before pulling a stunt like this.”
Quite right. If Ren and Itsuki hadn’t come to properly witness it, there’d be no way for me to follow through, I say.
“Yuki-chan and the others are off playing elsewhere for now, pyon. If Ren and Itsuki happen to come by, they’re set to strap a dummy of me on their backs and make a run for it, pyon.”

Since I happen to be quite skilled at sewing, I can even make stuffed decoys, pyon. By now, Ren and Itsuki, having dashed off, might well have found Yuki-chan and the others and be chasing after them bloodshot-eyed and disgraced, deathpyon.
“I see… well, now I understand what Gaelion-chan meant by ‘just confess already.’”
“Was it that surprising, indeed? Truly unexpected, pyon.”

“No, I think pretty much everyone already assumed it was you. Even Itsuki had caught on, hadn’t he? With heroes getting hit one after another while only you and I stayed unscathed—that’s a little too convenient, don’t you think?”
“Gaelion doesn’t think that’s the case, pyon.”
Must just be my imagination, pyon. There’s no way Ren and Itsuki have that sharp an intuition, pyon. Then again, why did it end up making such a fool of me, pyon?
